events.text: The Victoria returns to Spain, completing the first circumnavigation of the Earth.
U.S. President William McKinley is shot in Buffalo, New York.
South African Prime Minister Hendrik Verwoerd is assassinated in parliament.
Swaziland gains independence from the United Kingdom.
Cal Ripken Jr. breaks Lou Gehrig's record for consecutive baseball games played.
The funeral of Diana, Princess of Wales, is watched by billions worldwide.
